limitations_admitted.value: LVG parameters highly degenerate; best-fit values reflect relative trends only

evidence.quote: due to the high degeneracy among the LVG parameters, even with a handful of CO lines one could not obtain results simultaneously constraining $n_{\rm H_2}$, $T_{\rm kin}$, and $N(\mathrm{H_2})$

limitations_admitted.value: Sample biased to upper main sequence and warm dust by PACS detection requirement

evidence.quote: We note that the initial requirement of a PACS detection steered the sample towards upper main-sequence objects and warm dust temperatures $T_{\rm dust}\gtrsim 30$ K.
